summary: @servicetitan/line-item-editor preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a React line-item editor UI component library, but its `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases` and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` to execute a 727KB heavily obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle shipped in the tarball. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are obfuscated with hex-named identifiers, string-array rotation, and character-permutation decoders (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`), concealing what runs at install. A React UI component library has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque install-time payload; the Bun download exists solely to run bundled code the Node engine cannot inspect. On any `npm install` of this version, the developer/CI machine automatically fetches a second runtime and executes ~727KB of obfuscated code with full user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
